svg.title: Conditional steel temperature after a ten-second heating pulse
svg.desc: Computed inner-face temperatures in the steel band alongside the sleeve, not measurements. The central fixed, already-recessed sleeve case peaks at 59.3 degrees Celsius, 555 seconds after heating starts. Three selected geometry, char-conductivity and cooling comparisons are shown. All use assumed material properties and an intact radial path; real cracks and ablation are not modeled.

g.text: The steel can keep warming after the flame is off
CONDITIONAL CONDUCTION SCENARIOS · NOT MEASURED HOTFIRE TEMPERATURES
Central case: ≈59 °C peak at 9.3 min; initial temperature 20 °C.
Fixed wall and assumed properties · no cracks, evolving ablation, or engine-safety validation
